text:
Peach

A local-first video metadata scraper and media manager.

Website · Download · Live demo · Documentation · 简体中文

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Screenshots

 

Movie demo data; see asset credits and licenses.

 
 More screenshots 

 People and works 

 

 Creator updates 

 

 Library statistics 

 

 Player 

 

 

 Features

- Metadata scraping : recognize video codes, read NFO files and fill titles, performers, studios and covers from multiple sources while keeping your edits.
- Local and cloud libraries : browse local drives, SMB, mounted cloud storage and PikPak libraries together.
- Playback and history : web and external players, subtitles, playback speed, rotation, resume and timeline previews.
- Follows and discovery : track performer and creator updates, discover titles and manage a want list.
- Cloud download : search by video code or submit a magnet link, then organize completed downloads into your library.
- Library management : manage tags, duplicates, versions and parts; permanently delete videos by performer while keeping profiles and photos. Metadata and watch history are stored locally.
- Task center : pause, resume or cancel local background tasks and view their CPU, GPU and download activity where available.

 Download and use

 Method Get started 
 --- --- 
 Windows x64 Installer · Portable 
 macOS Apple Silicon / ARM64 · Intel / x86 64 
 Docker / NAS Deployment guide 
 Source Setup instructions; requires Git, uv and Python 3.14+ 

Choose your media folders after installation, then scan to start browsing and playing. Desktop test builds are unsigned, and macOS builds are not notarized. See the Windows and macOS guides.

 Documentation

Operations · Sources · External players · Diagnostics and data sharing · Changelog

Development: Contributing · Development guide · Testing

 Reporting problems

Report a bug or suggest a feature with your version, steps and error message. Use demo data in public screenshots and redact private information; do not upload videos or databases. Report vulnerabilities privately through the security policy.

 Translation

Peach is translated on Hosted Weblate. The current English is an AI draft, so suggestions and votes are welcome. See Contributing for the details.

 Related projects

Thanks to amane, Gfriends and CloudDrive2. See the reuse inventory for full credits.

Manage only media you own or are authorized to use, subject to laws, copyright and source-platform access, age and regional restrictions. Peach does not provide video resources or access to paid content.
